news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: DJ Moore questionable to return with shoulder injury
news.desc: DJ Moore is questionable to return with a shoulder injury.
news.impact: Viewers of the broadcast were able to see Moore get up and walk off under his own power after taking a big hit in the endzone. However, he is headed to the locker room for further x-ray examination and is questionable to return.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) active for Thursday night
news.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) is active for the Lions game against the Bills on Thursday.
news.impact: Reed was initially questionable to play with a foot injury, but was not among the inactives list. The veteran will try to bolster a struggling secondary against a passing attack that took down Houston on Sunday.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: T.J. Sanders (illness) inactive for Thursday
news.desc: T.J. Sanders (illness) is inactive for the Bills game against the Lions on Thursday.
news.impact: Sanders went down with an illness earlier this week and won't make it back in time for the Bills home opener. Landon Jackson is next in line for snaps, so expect an increased role on his part.
